RULE_1_ADMISSIBILITY.statement: a book is valued ONLY if its recorded scoring closure equals the frozen closure.

RULE_2_PRE_FREEZE_BOOKS_ARE_VALUED_THROU.statement: a book built before the freeze is valued through a freeze-built rebuild proven CONTENT-IDENTICAL to it under da_book_identity_declaration_v1.

CONTENT_IDENTITY_VERIFIED_INDEPENDENTLY_.method: DA's own canonical table digests over both pickles -- NOT BE's diff artifact. Rule 38: convergence is evidence only if the instruments differed.

RULE_4_REPORTABLE_NEVER_REFUSABLE.when: every unnamed member's recorded digest equals the file on disk (DE 336: reportable iff it has not MOVED)
RULE_4_REPORTABLE_NEVER_REFUSABLE.never_refusable_because: static reachability OVER-APPROXIMATES the run: a lazily imported module on an untaken branch is in the derived set and legitimately absent from the recording. Bytes that did not run and did not change cannot have changed the scores.

be_score_neutrality.py.NOTE: *** THIS ONE IS BEYOND THE RULED LAZY EXEMPTION. *** The exemption has TWO members; the unnamed set has THREE. be_score_neutrality.py is reportable ONLY under DE 336's has-not-MOVED rule, not under the lazy exemption -- and the exemption is NOT widened to include it.
